report.overall_status: Confirmed SSH-Bruteforce attack detected across multiple time windows.
report.explanation: Multiple consecutive 30-second windows show high confidence (ranging from 0.82 to 0.90) detection of an SSH-Bruteforce attack. Both flow-level and window-level predictions consistently identify this attack type, with high flow density and window occupancy observed across all alerts. The attack appears sustained over the reported period.
recommended_actions: Identify and block the source IP addresses involved in the bruteforce attempts.
Review SSH server logs for successful or attempted logins.
Implement or strengthen SSH security measures such as rate-limiting connection attempts, using key-based authentication, and enabling multi-factor authentication.
Ensure SSH services are not exposed to the internet unnecessarily.
